content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Meghalaya Tourism Development Corporation Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Meghalaya Tourism Development Corporation to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Meghalaya Tourism Development Corporation recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Meghalaya Tourism Development Corporation contractual posts is 11th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by Meghalaya Tourism Development Corporation?
faq.answer: Meghalaya Tourism Development Corporation has released a total of 16 vacancies for various contractual posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Bachelor in Hotel Management from IHM or a recognized institution, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 32 years, with a relaxation of 5 years for ST/SC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the contractual posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 20,000/- to Rs. 50,000/- per month, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official Meghalaya Tourism Development Corporation website.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What are the different posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts include Bartender, Barback, Waiter/Service Staff, Sous Chef, Senior Barista, and Junior Barista.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the employment?
faq.answer: The posts are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is available in the "Important Links" section of this article.
